name: Upbit session VWAP trend and dip-reversion family
author: SpreadAtlas
instruments: Upbit KRW spot; 12 large coins in study

indicators.VWAP: trade-size weighted average since session open

entry_long: Trend variant: hold while close > session VWAP
exit: For dip variants, sell when close returns above VWAP; for trend rule leave when no longer above VWAP
position_sizing: Equal money per coin in cited comparison
filters: Close-based signal, next-bar-open fill; thresholds are grouped parameter variants
claimed_performance: Source reports 2% dip only sometimes positive after costs; source backtest, not independent.
implementation_notes: Threshold values are alternatives in one strategy JSON as requested; same-day VWAP resets at 09:00 KST.
